static_traits.name: 陈诺
static_traits.family_status: 有两个Female儿，喜欢与她们一起购物和相处
static_traits.social_status: 有亲密朋友和配偶可交谈，但尚not yet与他们讨论烹饪困扰
static_traits.medical_history: not yet出现类似心理问题的既往史；not yet接受过其他心理问题的治疗或咨询；without显著躯体疾病
static_traits.language_features: 配合度高、表达清晰，能具体描述Anxiety与自动化思维；言语中常出现绝对化与灾难化表述

basic_info.main_problem: I always feel that every dish I make is terrible, even though I take cooking as a hobby and enjoy it.
basic_info.core_demands: I realized that lacking confidence in my cooking ability affects my enjoyment of a hobby I once loved, so I am seeking counseling.
growth_experiences: 几个月前的几次烹饪实验失败后，压力从中度开始升高；此后Entering the kitchen时就会Anticipation失败并产生Anxiety，逐渐Avoids cooking、更多依赖外卖，感到沮丧；原本以烹饪作为与家人建立联结的活动也受到影响。

special_situations.event: Whenever walking into the kitchen to start cooking
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I start cooking, I will most likely fail and the dishes will turn out terrible
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids cooking，选择点外卖以减少失望和Anxiety
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: This will be another disaster / I am bound to fail

special_situations.event: When trying a new dish or attempting to make a recipe perfect
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果have not达到完美标准就等于失败
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Puts very high pressure on oneself, repeatedly watches tutorials and reads recipes, pursues perfection

special_situations.event: Reviews cooking experiences, recalls several past failed attempts
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 失败说明我not行，成功not具有证明力
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 忽视或贬低做得好的部分，Reinforcement失败记忆

special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 一次失败就说明我总体not擅长烹饪
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Applying negative labels, fewer retry attempts
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我not如自己以为的会做饭/我根本not行

core_conflict.wish: Longing to experience competence and pleasure in cooking, and to maintain connection with family through cooking
core_conflict.fear: 害怕再次失败、被证明not行，进而丧失对烹饪的信心与家庭联结的方式
defense_goal: 通过Avoids cooking来降低失望与Anxiety
Holding oneself to perfect standards to gain a sense of control

object_relations.self_representation: not自信、容易失败的烹饪者
object_relations.object_representation: Family serves as significant others and connection objects (cooking is the expectation and pathway for connecting with them)

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When walking into the kitchen or thinking about trying a new dish
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 将任何偏差或not完美视为彻底失败，并把失败当作“我not行”的证据
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 语气温和与支持，use开放式问题引导陈诺具体化“失败/成功”的证据；进行正常化与小步计划，避免评判，鼓励逐步尝试。

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor invites one to focus on present emotions or successful experiences
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 倾向以教程、步骤与技术分析来替代情绪探究，从而避开not适感
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 先Empathy再轻柔回到当下体验，use情感标注与具身化Questioning（如关注身体感受），保持缓慢节奏与短句，留出停顿以促进觉察。

manifestations: Once-loved cooking has lost its joy and meaning
Cooking as an activity connecting with family is affected
outcomes: 对爱好的Reduced sense of enjoyment

manifestations: Avoiding cooking reduces the cooking time shared with family
outcomes: Feeling lost from reduced interaction with family

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: Treats 'perfection' as the only acceptable standard
以“必须做到完美才not算失败”的规则自我约束

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Excessively worries about failing next time in the kitchen
Berates oneself excessively, hard to acknowledge the parts done well

exception_events.target_problem: 在Walking into the kitchen to cook时，陈诺通常会Anticipation失败、感到Anxiety并选择回避，改为点外卖。
exception_events.unique_outcome: When making a few signature dishes, she can complete the dishes relatively stably.
exception_events.reason: not同情境：对这些菜更熟悉、步骤更清晰，既往成功经验可作为证据，Anxiety相对较低。

positive_force: Retains love for cooking and motivation to return to it
Willing to learn and practice (watch tutorials, read recipes)
Positive attitude; willing to record and examine thoughts
有配偶与朋友的社会支持资源（尽管尚not yet求助）
Has a few signature dishes that can be done reliably
negative_force: Discounting positive experiences, mentally filtering negative details
完美主义标准导致压力与Self-denial

target_behavior.behavior: Entering the kitchen时Significant anxiety并Anticipation失败，随后Avoids cooking
antecedent: Walking into the kitchen to cook
Trying new dishes or attempting to perfect recipes
target_behavior.core_reason: 几次失败的烹饪尝试后形成灾难化与非黑即白的认知，认为not完美即失败并以此证明“我not行”。
target_behavior.function: 逃避可能的失败与失望，短期降低Anxiety
target_behavior.consequence: Relies on takeout, eating habits affected; fewer bonding activities with family; interest in and enjoyment of cooking decline
